item.title: Version 1.8.0
item.description:
• Fixed sticky windows sometimes not shrinking back down after being resized wider
  • Control+1…0 jumps straight to any of your first ten stickies
  • Checklists edit more like a real text editor: split/merge lines with Return/Backspace, arrow keys move between the title and items
  • Checking off an item now has a small animation, plus ⌘Z/⌘⇧Z to undo/redo completions
  • Archived stickies now browse right on the Home screen instead of a separate window — click to restore, right-click to delete for good
  • Drag and drop to reorder your stickies on Home
  • Stickies can now sync across your devices via iCloud

item.title: Version 1.7.0
item.description:
• New "Report a Bug…" in the status menu: text + optional screenshot, sent straight to feedback
  • Fixed the report form's cursor showing the app's green accent instead of a neutral color
  • Support for occasional in-app announcements going forward
